advertencias: Rows are kept exactly as SIAP reports them; prices are not corrected, smoothed or imputed.
SIAP does not separate bean varieties: 'Frijol' is mapped to Modelo's 'frijol_pinto'.
Only rows in 'Tonelada' are included; no unit conversion was applied.
Older raw files name the price column 'Precio' and the crop column 'Nomcultivo Sin Um'; those aliases are read as-is.
